name: Nonlinear Dynamics
description: Introduction to concept of trajectories, phase space, singular points and limit cycle; linear stability analysis and introduction to bifurcations; analytical methods including perturbation techniques, and heuristic approaches like harmonic balance and equivalent linearization; stability of periodic solutions: Floquet's theory, Hill's and Mathieu's equations; nonlinear free and forced responses of the Duffing's and van der Pol equation; introduction to chaos and Lyapunov exponents.
